name_zh: 杜桑·卢维杜尔/海地革命：黑人革命与第一黑人共和国
name_en: Toussaint Louverture/Haitian Revolution: Black Revolution & First Black Republic
description_zh: 海地杜桑·卢维杜尔 (1743-1803) 奴隶起义领袖/1791 起义/1794 废除奴隶制/1801 宪法/1802 拿破仑远征/1803 卢维杜尔狱中逝世/1804 让-雅克·德萨林宣布独立/第一黑人共和国/赔偿法国/长期孤立/杜瓦利埃/阿里斯蒂德/2010 地震/帮派暴力。核心革命逻辑：奴隶起义/废奴/黑人主权/赔偿债务/外交孤立/内部精英/外部干预/国家建构。体现 M209 黑人革命建国 — 以"奴隶起义即建国+废奴即宪法+赔偿即原罪+孤立即生存"四位一体，在种植园经济/拿破仑远征/赔偿债务/长期孤立四重历史重压下构建第一黑人主权国家。
description_en: Haiti Toussaint Louverture (1743-1803) slave revolt leader/1791 uprising/1794 abolition/1801 Constitution/1802 Napoleonic expedition/1803 Louverture dies in prison/1804 Jean-Jacques Dessalines declares independence/first Black republic/reparations to France/long isolation/Duvalier/Aristide/2010 earthquake/gang violence. Core revolutionary logic: slave uprising/abolition/Black sovereignty/reparations debt/diplomatic isolation/internal elites/external intervention/state-building. Exemplifies M209 Black Revolution Nation-Building — quaternity of 'slave uprising as founding + abolition as constitution + reparations as original sin + isolation as survival' building first Black sovereign nation amid quadruple historical weight of plantation economy/Napoleonic expedition/reparations debt/long isolation.
reason_zh: 海地革命非单纯独立战争，而是"奴隶起义+废奴+黑人主权"三位一体世界史转折。1791 奴隶起义震撼大西洋世界，1804 首个黑人共和国打破白人至上神话，赔偿法国 1.5 亿法郎(现值 200 亿+) 成发展原罪。M209 区隔于 M196 佛教民族主义(缅甸)、M201 人民力量(菲律宾)、M202 抵抗建国(东帝汶)，核心在于"奴隶即建国主体+废奴即世界史转折+赔偿即发展原罪"的黑人革命建国范式。
reason_en: Haitian Revolution not mere independence war but 'slave uprising + abolition + Black sovereignty' trinity world-historical turning point. 1791 slave uprising shook Atlantic world, 1804 first Black republic shattered white supremacy myth, reparations to France 150M francs (today $20B+) became development original sin. M209 distinct from M196 Buddhist Nationalism (Myanmar), M201 People Power (Philippines), M202 Resistance Nation-Building (Timor-Leste), core: 'slaves as founding subjects + abolition as world-historical turn + reparations as development original sin' Black revolution nation-building paradigm.
steps_zh: 奴隶起义即建国合法性：1791 布瓦凯曼仪式/起义/杜桑/让-雅克/比亚索/图桑军事/政治天才/废奴/自治/宪法
废奴即世界史宪法转折：1794 法国废奴/1802 拿破仑恢复/1801 宪法/杜桑终身总督/黑人/混血/白人三色旗/公民平等
赔偿债务即发展原罪：1825 法国承认/1.5 亿法郎/高利贷/1947 还清/200 亿+ 现值/阿里斯蒂德索赔/法国拒付/发展窃取
外交孤立与内部精英：美国 1862 承认/杜瓦利埃父子/阿里斯蒂德/政变/联合国/非政府组织/帮派/国家脆弱/赔偿阴影
第一黑人共和国遗产：泛非主义/黑人尊严/赔偿正义/气候脆弱/帮派/青年/侨民/海地精神永存
steps_en: Slave uprising as founding legitimacy: 1791 Bois Caïman ceremony/uprising/Louverture/Jean-Jacques/Biassou/Toussaint military-political genius/abolition/autonomy/constitution
Abolition as world-historical constitutional turn: 1794 France abolishes/1802 Napoleon restores/1801 Constitution/Louverture governor-for-life/Black/mulatto/white tricolor/civic equality
Reparations debt as development original sin: 1825 France recognition/150M francs/usury/1947 paid off/$20B+ today/Aristide demanded reparations/France refused/development stolen
Diplomatic isolation & internal elites: US 1862 recognition/Duvalier dynasty/Aristide/coups/UN/NGOs/gangs/state fragility/reparations shadow
First Black Republic legacy: Pan-Africanism/Black dignity/reparations justice/climate fragility/gangs/youth/diaspora/Haitian spirit endures
expected_zh: 以"奴隶起义+废奴+赔偿+孤立"四位一体，在种植园经济/拿破仑远征/赔偿债务/长期孤立四重重压下构建第一黑人主权国家，为黑人世界提供革命建国范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'slave uprising + abolition + reparations + isolation' builds first Black sovereign nation amid quadruple historical weight, providing revolution nation-building paradigm for Black world.
